Emails a one-click link for the given address. If the email belongs to an existing user, it's a login link; otherwise, when registration allows it, this creates the account first and the link both confirms the email and logs them in. Always responds identically regardless of outcome.

refresh_token_ttl_seconds.description: Refresh token TTL in seconds (null = default: 604800s / 7d)

overview_metrics.description: Overview tiles the tenant selected, as BillingStatsDto keys. Empty = never customised, so the dashboard applies its own default set. Filtered server-side against the supported keys.

password_policy.description: What the server will accept as a password for this tenant. Public so the prebuilt components can state the rules in the form instead of surfacing them through a rejected submit.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date for the invitation code (ISO 8601 format). Null or omitted means no expiration

maxUses.description: How many times this code can be redeemed before it stops working. Defaults to 1 (single-use).
